r8: When a vehicle is 5–10 m ahead in the lane and the car is closing in on it (more than 5 m/s faster), slow down; but if no other vehicle is seen, change lanes instead: to either side from the middle lane, to the right from the leftmost lane, to the left from the rightmost lane.
r8b: When a vehicle is 5–10 m ahead in the lane and the car is closing in on it (more than 5 m/s faster), never accelerate.
r28: When a vehicle is right next to the car in the lane to its left, do not change lanes to the left.
r29: When a vehicle is right next to the car in the lane to its right, do not change lanes to the right.
r30: When the car is in the leftmost lane, do not change lanes to the left.
